test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is equal to 0.1overline{ 82 } ?
solution:
Given:

{{We have to find a rational number of }}0.1overline {82} 

Calculation:

{{Let x }} = {{ }}0.1overline {82} 

Multiply by 10 both sides

⇒ 10x = 1.828282… ----(1)

Multiply by 100 on both sides

⇒ 1000x = 182.8282… ----(2)

Subtract (1) from (2)

⇒ 1000x – 10x = 182.8282 – 1.8282

⇒ 990x = 181

⇒ x = 181/990

∴ Rational number is 181/990.
